problem_statement: The buyer needs one defined repository evidence source converted into FreshContext-compatible candidate context with deterministic acceptance.
dependencies: Read-only access to the agreed repository/API
background_ip_notes: FreshContext Core, decision logic, source profiles, verification methods and reusable integration utilities remain Background IP.
Historical MIT releases remain under their historical MIT rights.

acceptance_tests.expected_observable_result: The schema validates each agreed fixture with zero validation errors.

acceptance_tests.description: Known fixture converts to candidate context
acceptance_tests.expected_observable_result: The adapter emits one signal containing the agreed source, content, published_at, retrieved_at and date_confidence fields.
The adapter returns a documented failure result and does not emit a success signal.
